title: jobcrawl resolved event (resolved/v1)
description: One status transition of a posting across boards, written by the resolver job (core/resolve). Numbered by the resolver's own seq (+1 per record); src_event_id is the global event_id of the per-board record (or checkpoint) it came from. Per-board streams say what one board observed; this stream says what the posting is: open, a cross-listed dup of another posting, hidden by every board's filters, departed, or unknown.

op.description: added: first time open; reappeared: open again after hidden/departed/unknown; undup: a dup takes over because its original left; changed: fields or boards changed while visible (suspect: two different posting keys resolved to this id)

admitting.description: boards that listed and kept the posting within the 48 h admission hold

excerpt.description: optional: the first ~1,200 characters of the representative posting description, as the store keeps it
